measurement: API usage and client request duration; not hardware telemetry
assumptions: Illustrative request-attributed constant power multiplied by client API duration. Queue/network time, server sharing, idle power, PUE and all local/chain energy are unknown. These are not measured service energy or NPU/GPU savings.
avoided_calls: Fixed approved opening and duplicate request compile in code; all signing, policy, settlement and repeat-purchase checks use zero inference.
